camera_shots.name: Hillview Golden Hour
camera_shots.reference: Golden Hour on the Abandoned Hillside(1).png
camera_shots.lighting: Golden hour; sunset low over valley, gentle warm fill; isolated emergency vehicle lamps
camera_shots.focus_notes: Tree-framed downhill street; varied intact facades and balconies; neighborhood scale foreground; mountain skyline far behind.
mandatory: Retaining walls and hillside apartments follow grade
2.4 m uninterrupted footpath and human-scale entrances
Mature street trees frame street without blocking escape path
Sparse luggage, car and emergency van; majority of facades intact
Warm golden light and blue-grey snowy peaks in distance

camera_shots.name: Central Arch Station Arrival
camera_shots.lighting: Cool overcast morning; station glazing luminous; selected triage lights and high wet-ground reflection
camera_shots.focus_notes: Large legible twin arched terminal roof dominating upper frame, raised viewpoint over forecourt and triage/bus routes.
mandatory: Two arch barrel forms remain visually dominant
Bus berths, safety paths, temporary triage tents legible in foreground
Glossy rain-dark concrete, scattered but restrained luggage
Station access aligns with bus/taxi circulation
Snow mountains remain behind the station, not as local traversable slopes

camera_shots.name: Capitol Lockdown Boulevard
camera_shots.lighting: Blue-grey storm daylight, wet asphalt reflections; red traffic signals and localized warning beacons
camera_shots.focus_notes: Long one-point civic corridor, intact pale monumental hall in distance, tree-lined glass towers and vehicle barricades.
mandatory: Formal boulevard centered on the capitol landmark
Institutional stone architecture with restrained glass towers
Wrecked or abandoned vehicles are localized rather than continuous rubble
Rain puddles and emergency signal highlights with grounded reflection
Two-way pedestrian clearance around road checkpoints

camera_shots.name: Southland Airport Evacuation Approach
camera_shots.lighting: Late dusk under storm clouds; streetlights and portable floodlights with wet-road specular highlights
camera_shots.focus_notes: Massive dark flyover on left and wet traffic queue leading to terminal hangar and control tower on right horizon.
mandatory: Viaduct underside anchors left composition
Queue of passenger vehicles and one viable rescue detour
Floodlit field medical tents integrated along highway
Control tower and terminal roof distinguishable near horizon
Dusk storm lighting and localized wet road highlights

camera_shots.name: Capital and Mountain Panorama
camera_shots.lighting: Cold bright-overcast afternoon, broken clouds; crisp readable urban materials and subdued smoke
camera_shots.focus_notes: Wooded hill slope in front, dense but intact modern CBD in middle distance, snowy ridge in distant upper background.
mandatory: Urban area shows dense center with residential parks and river bridges
Snowy mountains lie geographically north behind city
Visible 8 km release footprint is not mislabeled as 940 sq km region
Modern skyline stays mostly intact with few smoke plumes
Airport remains south of city and outside northern skyline view
